mapper.sql: e.id, e.source_type, e.source_id, e.source_slot, e.category_code, e.label, e.amount, e.spent_date, e.actor_user_id, e.request_id, e.request_hash, e.version, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, e.del_flag

select from preg_expense e where e.source_type = #{sourceType} and e.source_id = #{sourceId} and e.source_slot = #{sourceSlot} and e.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select from preg_expense e where e.actor_user_id = #{actorUserId} and e.request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into preg_expense ( source_type, source_id, source_slot, category_code, label, amount, spent_date, actor_user_id, request_id, request_hash, version, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceSlot}, #{categoryCode}, #{label}, #{amount}, #{spentDate}, #{actorUserId}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, 1, #{createBy}, now(3) )
mapper.update: update preg_expense set category_code = #{categoryCode}, label = #{label}, amount = #{amount}, spent_date = #{spentDate}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'

update preg_expense set del_flag = '2', version = version + 1, update_time = now(3) where source_type = #{sourceType} and source_id = #{sourceId} and del_flag = '0'
